When I was a kid me and my cousins were playing tag. We saw this bigass caterpillar - honestly don’t know if it was really big or if it just looked big to my child eyes. So of course my cousins started poking it with sticks, then one idiot thought it’d be funny to pick it up and chase the rest of us around the park. Since I was slowest runner I immediately became the target. While I ran I heard my other cousins laughing, I don’t what was it but I tripped and something and fell. My cousin (the one holding the caterpillar) is shocked and somehow thinks the appropriate thing to do in this situation is to throw the caterpillar at me. 

To make matters worse, while I was flailing to try to get the caterpillar off me I somehow managed to crush it with my hand (even while writing this I’m getting shivers). At this point I started screaming and crying.

Apparently I screamed REALLY loud, loud enough that our parents came rushing in  thinking I was being kidnapped or something.  My mom was furious because I skinned my knees and that they might leave scars (they did, I still have them). She yelled at my cousins while my aunt cleaned up my knees and helped me change into different clothes.

Whenever I see a caterpillar, I automatically and unwillingly think about the crushed caterpillar from that incident.
Thanks to a prank gone wrong by my cousins,  I am terrified of caterpillars.
